title: Sina e akbar mein barchi ka utarna dekhiye
body:
Sina-e Akbar me barchi ka utarna dekhiye
Sath barchi ke kaleje ka nikalna dekhiye
Khech kar sine se barchi ye kaha shabbir ne
Dada ibrahim mera sabr karna dekhiye
Bibiyon ke shor me ek shor tha akber mera
Khun bhare kurte se zainab ka lipat na dekhiye
Khoon mei dubi hue karbobala ne di sada
Pusht se godhe ki Akbar ka utar na dekhiye
Hazrate yaaqoob dekhein fakhrein yusuf ki ada
Jism se Roohe jigar ka yu bichadna dekhiye
Chin gae aankhon se mere zindagi ki roshni
Dasht me yu jaan -e-zahra ka bikharna dekhiye
Aaega lene mujhe bhaiyya mera kadyal jawaan
Yaad mei Akbar ke sughra  ka tadap na dekhiye.
Kya padhe shabrez yawar naujawan ka marsiya
Ghum zada ahle aza ka khoon rona dekhiye
